name: ugh, kids
source:
"ugh, kids" is a game about having to substitute as a kindergarten teacher for a lovely bunch of students.  Kids are insufferable, but hey! Some have hot single dads...

This prototype is made for NaNoReNo 2023.

[From [url=https://manythamks.itch.io/ugh-kids]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《呃，孩子们》是一款关于必须代替一群可爱的学生担任幼儿园老师的游戏。孩子们难以忍受，但是嘿！有些人有性感的单亲爸爸……

该原型是为NaNoReNo 2023制作的。

[来自[url=https://manythamks.itch.io/ugh-kids]Itch.io[/url]]
